intro: One glass of air tebu has about 180 kcal (estimate). All the calories come from the natural sugar in sugarcane juice.
diet: Yes, but don't be fooled by the 'natural' label. Sugar in air tebu is still sugar, and it won't fill you up. A small glass once in a while, especially on a hot day, is still okay. Avoid the big plastic bag and don't make it an everyday drink.
tips: Pick a small size or share a glass with a friend.
Ask for more ice so there's less juice in the glass.
Drink it with a proper meal, not as an extra drink between meals.

swap.name: Unsweetened coconut water
swap.why: Still refreshing and naturally sweet, but only one-third of the calories.

faq.q: Is air tebu healthier than other sugary drinks?
faq.a: It has a few minerals, but the sugar is still high. Treat it like any other sweet drink.

faq.q: Why does air tebu go bad so fast?
faq.a: Fresh juice oxidises and ferments easily. Best to drink it within an hour or two after it's pressed.

faq.q: Why add lime or asam boi to air tebu?
faq.a: To balance the sweetness and give a fresh sour taste. It only adds a few calories.
